name: Ichorwell Raider
source: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Disaster at Dreamlink Labs

items.name: Freebooter Armor
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

offensiveAbilities.name: Siphon Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The Ichorwell raider has a creature Grabbed

Effect The raider uses its proboscis to drink the blood of the grabbed creature, dealing 1d4 Untyped Damage damage. A creature that has its blood drained by a raider is Drained 1 until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spew Vomit
offensiveAbilities.description: The Ichorwell raider spews vomit in a 15ft Type:cone, dealing 2d6 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 16 Fortitude Saving Throw save). The Ichorwell raider can't Spew Vomit again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

cantrips.name: Daze
cantrips.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also Stunned 1.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

lv2spells.name: Augury
lv2spells.description:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret DC 6 Flat . On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.
